title: Beat lanes
description: The playfield of a rhythm game for interactive clips: four lanes on a highway into the distance, notes riding down to a hit line on the beat, pads that light under a tap or a key (D F J K or the arrows), bursts and PERFECT/GOOD labels where a note is caught, a count-in, a combo and a progress line. Emits perfect and good when a note is caught and miss when a lane is pressed with no note in reach. The chart comes from bpm, bars and seed, so it fits a music-loop at the same tempo. Takes a theme.

bpm.description: Tempo of the music the chart follows

countIn.description: Beats of count-in before the first note (3, 2, 1, go)

bars.description: Bars of notes after the count-in

seed.description: Picks the lanes of the chart

keys.description: The key of each lane, left to right (the arrows work too)

travel.description: Seconds a note takes from the distance to the line at speed 1

speed.description: How fast the notes ride (1 = normal, 2 = twice as fast): bind it to an options slider

window.description: Seconds either side of the beat a note can be caught

perfect.description: Seconds either side of the beat that count as perfect

combo.description: The current combo, drawn above the highway from 2 up (bind it to a variable)

author: claude-opus-5-5
